requirements.title: Second CI-M subject
requirements.summary: At least one requirement or elective must use a second CI-M subject from the department CIM2 list, beyond the application CI-M requirement. The linked general CI-M list has been inspected, but its exact CIM2 applicability remains unresolved.

requirements.title: SERC module credit condition
requirements.summary: Credit for 6.C01 requires completion of a 6-unit disciplinary module; consult an advisor. Do not treat its listed 6 units as sufficient by itself.

requirements.title: General Institute Requirements
requirements.summary: The chart summarizes 17 GIR subjects: six science, eight HASS (at least two CI-H), two REST (identified as 6.1200 and 18.C06), and one laboratory requirement (identified as 6.1010, 12 units). Detailed distributions and choice pools remain unreviewed.

requirements.title: Physical education and swimming
requirements.summary: Complete the swimming requirement and four physical education courses totaling eight points. Points are not academic units.

requirements.title: Major, GIR overlap and degree accounting
requirements.summary: The chart reports 168–177 major units, 36 major units also satisfying GIRs, and 180–189 units beyond the GIRs. Units for any of the 17 GIR subjects cannot also count toward units required beyond the GIRs. Ranges are preserved, not replaced with a fabricated single total.

requirements.title: Linked general CI-M reference list
requirements.summary: The degree chart links this general EECS CI-M list, but the page does not identify a CIM2 subset. These course observations are a reference pool, not a verified set of second-CI-M choices for Course 6-4.

notes: Partial degree inventory: chart-local choices and finite advanced/SERC pools are represented; linked institute and departmental completion policies are not fully reviewed. No first-offered date or catalog year is inferred from retrieval.

Programming bundles require all component subjects. Center requirements retain repeated course eligibility across areas without treating one observation as two courses. Listed SERC and CI-M conditions overlap other requirements and are not automatically extra subjects.

The chart gives 6.4300 as 15 units while the linked CI-M reference table gives 12. Its curated credit value is unknown pending reconciliation; both source observations are retained separately by refresh.

The linked CI-M page has no named CIM2 subset. Its 23 entries are represented as a reference note only, not certified as second-CI-M choices. Course 6/18 elective eligibility, GIR pools and degree-wide rules require more review.

Individual descriptions, prerequisites, public course sites and syllabi are unextracted. MIT source units stay units; calendar remains unknown. Unit ranges are preserved in notes rather than collapsed to one total.
